name: Ostkustleden Etapp 3, Lönhult - Krokstorp
description: Lönhult to Krokstorp. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Naturkartan page says 20.5 km, normalized GPX computes 20.549165 km with small joins, Döderhult/OSM/Pacer round to about 21 km, and raw GPX concatenation gives a false 54.841849 km because tracks are not in route order.
Official GPX and API contain ten pieces in non-sequential order and mixed directions.
PDF text extraction may read Krokshult, while official page, cabin page, map labels, and OSM use Krokstorp.

Naturkartan says well water on yard and lake water must be boiled if the well dries; Döderhult says the well water may be brown but potable; field reports from 2009, 2015 and 2017 repeatedly describe poor/low/cloudy water.

A 2015 field report says the overnight cabin is not the first cabin by the lake/bathing place and not directly on the shore, while official route text generally says Krokstorp/Krokstorpsjön near the endpoint.
Krokshult naturreservat has strict visitor rules but Etapp 3 overlap was not confirmed. Viråns vattensystem Natura 2000 contact near Lönhult/Näjern was found.

facilities.name: Övernattningsstuga Lönhult
facilities.description: Shared Etapp 2/3 endpoint cabin with electric hotplate, wood stove, simple kitchen, summer water at cabin corner, dry toilet behind the barn, and no outdoor fire.

facilities.name: Lönhult dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet behind the barn at the Lönhult cabin.

facilities.name: Krokstorps badplats
facilities.description: Bathing place near Krokstorpsjön shortly before the Krokstorp cabin. Official sources mention good bathing nearby, but do not infer toilet/waste/grill services from general bathing-place pages.

facilities.name: Övernattningsstuga Krokstorp / JUF-stugan
facilities.description: Locked Ostkustleden cabin for hikers only, with electricity, electric hotplate, simple kitchen and mattresses. Key is in the mailbox by the large white house up the hill before the cabin. No fires in any fireplaces and no outdoor fires.

facilities.name: Tent site by Krokstorp cabin
facilities.description: Tenting by the Krokstorp cabin is allowed with fee according to official cabin/payment guidance. No outdoor fires.
